answer: New identities start at a knoll of zero reputation, so launching many sybils means fronting real stake per identity with no payoff until vesting completes. Each agent must stake a bond that vests along a vine of sequential epochs, and rewards only reach their zenith after sustained honest work. Peers slash bonds on proven collusion, making mass fake accounts costlier than the honest rewards they chase. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
